verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page explicitly claims an AI code reviewer that "reviews all code changes and suggests fixes so you can merge faster," which matches the story directly. That sits alongside comprehensive PR review features. The evidence is marketing copy only, with no detail on how suggestions surface or get applied. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the AI reviewer (how fix suggestions appear and are applied in the PR, configuration, plan availability), independent or hands-on corroboration.
